title: deposit_accounting
description: A successful deposit(assets, receiver) returns shares = assets*RAY/chi with chi the Pot accumulator after drip, increases receiver's balance and totalSupply by exactly shares, moves exactly assets DAI from the caller, and increases SavingsDai's pie by exactly shares.

title: mint_accounting
description: A successful mint(shares, receiver) returns assets = ceil(shares*chi/RAY), increases receiver's balance and totalSupply by exactly shares, and moves exactly assets DAI from the caller.

title: withdraw_accounting
description: A successful withdraw(assets, receiver, owner) burns shares = ceil(assets*RAY/chi) from owner, decreases totalSupply and SavingsDai's pie by shares, and credits receiver with exactly assets DAI.

title: redeem_accounting
description: A successful redeem(shares, receiver, owner) burns exactly shares from owner, decreases totalSupply and SavingsDai's pie by shares, returns assets = floor(shares*chi/RAY) and credits receiver with exactly assets DAI.

title: withdraw_redeem_require_authorization
description: withdraw/redeem by a caller other than owner succeed only if allowance[owner][caller] covers the burned shares, and spend exactly that many shares of a finite allowance.

title: invalid_receiver_rejected
description: deposit and mint revert when the receiver is the zero address or SavingsDai itself.

title: previews_match_operations
description: In the same state and block, previewDeposit/previewMint/previewWithdraw/previewRedeem return exactly what deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem then return, even when the Pot has not been dripped.

title: conversions_round_in_vault_favor
description: previewMint(s) >= convertToAssets(s) and previewWithdraw(a) >= convertToShares(a): operations where the user specifies the output never charge less than the exact conversion.

title: max_functions_consistent
description: maxRedeem(owner) equals owner's share balance and maxWithdraw(owner) equals convertToAssets of that balance; maxDeposit and maxMint are unbounded.

title: no_profit_from_deposit_redeem_roundtrip
description: Rounding cannot be exploited: within one block, depositing assets and immediately redeeming the received shares never returns more DAI than deposited, and minting shares then withdrawing the paid assets never needs fewer shares than minted.

title: share_price_never_decreases
description: No SavingsDai operation decreases the Pot rate accumulator chi, so the DAI value of a share (convertToAssets) cannot be lowered by any user action.

title: vault_ops_do_not_affect_other_holders
description: deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem do not change the share balance of any account other than the receiver (deposit/mint) or owner (withdraw/redeem), so one user cannot dilute or drain another.
